title: Governance
description: A project's recorded trust profile: which changes may land on green required checks and an independent verdict without a human's approval of the pull request (workflow.yaml auto-land), and which always wait for one. A human chooses it, records why in an ADR with its reversal trigger, and changes it only by a commit to a protected path (authority.yaml never_grantable: change-policy). A project without one lands nothing without a human's approval. In every profile the spec is a human's to approve, an agent never approves its own work or bypasses a required check, and production is a human's release.

trust.description: solo: one maintainer; green required checks and the evaluator's verdict are the merge gate for low and medium risk. team: a code owner approves medium and high risk; low risk lands on green. regulated: every pull request is human-approved.

decision.description: The ADR that chose this profile and says why.

reversal_trigger.description: What moves the project to a stricter profile: a second maintainer, paying customers, a production regression from an unreviewed change.

auto_land.description: Which tasks may land without a human's approval. Absent, the profile's ceiling applies: solo medium, team low, regulated none. Never high, and never an irreversible task.

max_risk.description: The highest task risk that may auto-land (task risk, its level; a task with no risk is low). none turns auto-land off.

protected_paths.description: Path globs where checks are blind to what matters (walls, workflows, CODEOWNERS, this file): a change touching one always waits for a human's approval.

ui_paths.description: Path globs whose changes a person sees. A change touching one auto-lands only when visual_check names a required check that passed on its head.

visual_check.description: The required check that compares the changed screens (a visual diff). Absent, every change to a UI path waits for a human.

production.description: The production gate (workflow.yaml release). It stays a human's in every profile; continuous lets the train release on its own checks with automatic rollback, a human's config choice, solo only.

approvals.description: Humans who approve a production release.

signed_commits.description: The protected branch accepts signed commits only.

attestations.description: Every released artifact carries a build attestation.

allOf.description: team auto-lands low risk at most; regulated auto-lands nothing.
regulated: two production approvers, signed commits and build attestations.
Only a solo project may release continuously; team and regulated keep a human at the production gate.
